summary: Equinix, Inc. and its subsidiary Equinix Europe 2 Financing Corporation LLC filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an SEC-registered offering of multiple tranches of senior notes, each guaranteed by the parent. The filing is a routine debt financing under Rule 424(b)(5) within an existing shelf registration. Terms such as principal amounts, interest rates, and maturity dates are left blank pending pricing. The notes include optional redemption and a change-of-control put at 101%, but no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is present. This is an ordinary capital-markets transaction, not a special situation.
